s1.syndrome_frame: Acute febrile illness with flank pain and urinary symptoms
salient_findings: Escherichia coli growth in blood and urine cultures
key_facts: Immunosuppressive therapy with prednisone and tacrolimus
Urinalysis positive for leukocyte esterase, nitrites, and white blood cells
CT abdomen and pelvis shows non-obstructing right nephrolithiasis and irregular bladder wall thickening

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute febrile illness with flank pain and urinary symptoms
salient_findings: Escherichia coli growth in blood and urine cultures
key_facts: Immunosuppressive therapy with prednisone and tacrolimus
Urinalysis positive for leukocyte esterase, nitrites, and white blood cells
CT abdomen and pelvis shows non-obstructing right nephrolithiasis and irregular bladder wall thickening

differentials: Aspergillus infection of the urinary tract
Nocardial infection of the urinary tract
Renal papillary necrosis due to analgesic abuse
Squamous cell carcinoma of the bladder
per_call: Aspergillus infection of the urinary tract
Nocardial infection of the urinary tract
Renal papillary necrosis due to analgesic abuse
Squamous cell carcinoma of the bladder

shortlist.label: Pyelonephritis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has fever, flank pain, and positive urine culture for Escherichia coli

shortlist.label: Urinary tract infection
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has symptoms of UTI, including dysuria and foul-smelling urine, and positive urinalysis

shortlist.label: Bladder cancer
shortlist.why_kept: CT scan shows irregular, nodular thickening of the bladder wall, suspicious for neoplasm

shortlist.label: Kidney stone
shortlist.why_kept: CT scan shows non-obstructing right nephrolithiasis

shortlist.label: Cystitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has symptoms of cystitis, including dysuria and foul-smelling urine, and positive urinalysis

raw.rationale: The patient presents with fever, flank pain, and foul-smelling urine, and laboratory studies show leukocytosis, hyponatremia, and urinalysis positive for leukocyte esterase, nitrites, and white blood cells, with blood and urine cultures growing Escherichia coli, which are all consistent with a urinary tract infection

rejected.label: Pyelonephritis
rejected.why: While possible, the CT scan shows non-obstructing nephrolithiasis and bladder wall thickening, but does not specifically indicate pyelonephritis

rejected.label: Bladder cancer
rejected.why: The irregular bladder wall thickening is suspicious for neoplasm, but the patient's acute presentation with fever and positive urine cultures suggests an infectious process

rejected.label: Kidney stone
rejected.why: The patient has a non-obstructing kidney stone, but this does not explain the fever, leukocytosis, and positive urine cultures

rejected.label: Cystitis
rejected.why: Cystitis is a type of urinary tract infection, but the term 'urinary tract infection' is more encompassing and better explains the patient's symptoms and laboratory findings
